author: Stahly
description:
Few models command a battlefield quite like a dragon, and the Warriors of Chaos have just been handed one of the most imposing releases of the year. In this review, we unbox the new Lord on Chaos Dragon, walk through every build option with HQ sprue images, and take a close look at whether this colossal chaotic centrepiece lives up to its equally colossal price tag.

The post Unboxing the new Lord on Chaos Dragon: massive, gorgeous, and very expensive appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Unboxing the new Lord on Chaos Dragon: massive, gorgeous, and very expensive
